data.classification_note: MoD calls Agni-4 an MRBM; CSIS classes it an IRBM at 3,000-4,000 km. The disagreement is definitional (the MRBM/IRBM boundary is drawn at 3,000 km by some conventions and 3,500 km by others), not a factual dispute about range.
